svg.aria-label: Method in one row: my pushes, replayed in simulation and rendered with a Panda, train a latent world model whose target latents come from the same encoder; at test time a phone clip of a start and a goal pose sets the task and gradient descent on the latent objective picks the Panda's actions, replanning until the goal is reached.
svg.text: + regularizers on the path of z (Figure 3)
planning from a phone clip of the real T
through the predictor, to minimise ‖ẑH − zgoal‖
